updateMessage: CineVault v3.2.5 (5.2 MB) delivers instant zero-lag Search with 2-stage verified HD playback across all movies, series, and 630+ Live TV channels. Mandatory update for all older versions. Upgrading from v3.1.0 or older: uninstall the older app once first before installing.
changelog: Instant zero-lag Search launch (pre-warmed GPU overlay) and stutter-free typing on Android WebView
2-stage progressive search verification streams verified playable cards in <1s while enriching related hits
AbortSignal-aware native Android HTTP bridge cancels stale requests immediately on keystrokes
Pre-indexed sub-millisecond search across all 630+ Live TV channels & 100% verified playable catalog results
Mandatory update release compatible with v3.2.0-v3.2.4 (direct update over v3.2.x; v3.1.0 requires one-time clean reinstall)
